title: bug: VS Code protected store accepts missing POSIX roots beneath in-project symlink ancestors
description:
Reproduced while implementing task-648a5916 (also QA comment-c01fee7f): with outside/link -> project and stateRoot=outside/link/globalStorage/protected-state initially absent, isOutsideProject returns true and writeProtectedState returns true, writing under project/globalStorage/protected-state. pathForms walks missingRealPath only on win32.
This violates out-of-repository protected-state storage and also affects missing POSIX PATH leaves. Fix the shared helper/store in its own scoped row; keep task-648a5916's spawn-provenance scope separate.
definitionOfDone: Missing POSIX store/PATH leaves below a symlinked ancestor resolving inside the project are refused, matching the Windows/JetBrains containment behavior.
Regression tests cover initial absent roots, existing roots, outside-root success and refusal without any in-project record write.
reopenReason: Governor promotion, 07:08Z: HIGH, worker-filed with an independent repro. The VS Code protected store accepts a missing POSIX root beneath an in-project symlink ancestor, which breaks the owner-only-state rail. task-648a5916 is BLOCKED on it via blockedOnTaskIds.

comments.content: Confirmed impact on the new spawn provenance in scratch /tmp/moe-648a-red.0NbquU/store-diagnostic.log (no tracked edit): make .moe/project.json malformed so runtimeProfile returns protected without persisting a pin; select an absent storeRoot below outside/link -> project; call protected startDaemon. Diagnostic prints {outsideBefore:true,keyWrittenInsideProject:true,actualRecordInsideProject:true}; assertion that the record must not exist fails. This is not merely profile-pin wording: the store API can persist this row's secret key inside the project. Shared pathForms/store repair is outside task-648a5916's approved scope, so the provenance row will wait on this fix rather than patch the helper inline.
